read_aloud: A folded dispatch rests beneath a blue paperweight.
sensory_details: The paper smells faintly of mint.
A loose corner taps against the desk.

local_content.heading: Examine the dispatch
local_content.dm_text: No search roll. The dispatch is genuine; it records an inspection, not a new exit. Keep this evidence here, not with the Annex key. The seal matches the wrapper in [[room:vault]].
local_content.delivery: When someone unfolds the dispatch, show or read its text. Do not read it on arrival.
local_content.revealed_text: Inspection complete. The landing is unsafe. Send the warning before the next boat arrives. — Inspector Vale

local_content.heading: If someone calls for the inspector
local_content.dm_text: Vale has already left the building. Nobody answers; this does not start a hidden timer.
